definitions.explanation: A comparison or illustration used to explain something.
Used to introduce a hypothetical or concessive condition.

examples.japanese: {分|わ}かりやすい{例|たと}えを{使|つか}って{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain using an easy-to-understand example.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}え{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っても{行|い}きます。
examples.english: Even if it rains, I will go.

examples.japanese: その{例|たと}えはうまい。
{例|たと}えて{言|い}えば、{人生|じんせい}はマラソンのようなものだ。
examples.english: To use an analogy, life is like a marathon.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}えが{悪|わる}いかもしれないが、そんな{感|かん}じだ。
examples.english: It may be a poor analogy, but that's the idea.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもに{分|わ}かるように{身近|みぢか}な{例|たと}えを{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used a familiar analogy so the child could understand.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}え{失敗|しっぱい}しても{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: Even if I fail, I won't give up.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}え{遠|とお}くても{会|あ}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: Even if it's far, I'll go to see you.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}え{難|むずか}しくても{挑戦|ちょうせん}する{価値|かち}はある。
examples.english: Even if it's difficult, it's worth trying.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}え{時間|じかん}がかかっても、{最後|さいご}まで{自分|じぶん}の{力|ちから}でやりたい。
examples.english: Even if it takes time, I want to do it on my own to the end.

notes:
TWO DISTINCT USES:

1. AS A NOUN (example):
・{例|たと}えを{出|だ}す (to give an example)
・{例|たと}えが{悪|わる}い (a bad analogy)
・{例|たと}えて{言|い}えば (to use an analogy)

2. AS AN ADVERB (even if):
・{例|たと}え〜ても (even if ~)
・{例|たと}え〜でも (even though ~)
・Usually written in hiragana: たとえ

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{例|れい} - example (more formal, numbered examples)
・{比喩|ひゆ} - metaphor, figure of speech
・もし - if (neutral conditional)
